formats.key: emitLoan(((((uint256 offerId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256 capacity, address nftCollateralAddress, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration, uint256 maxSeniorRepayment, (address validator, bytes arguments)[] validators) offer, uint256 amount, bytes lenderOfferSignature)[] offerExecution, uint256 loanId, address nftCollateralAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 duration, uint256 expirationTime, address principalReceiver, bytes callbackData) executionData, address borrower, bytes borrowerOfferSignature) _loanExecutionData)
effects: The borrower's NFT (executionData.nftCollateralAddress, tokenId) moves from the borrower to the loan contract as escrow.
Each lender sends amount minus a prorated fee (offer.fee * amount / offer.principalAmount) of the principal token to principalReceiver.
The borrower takes on a debt equal to the sum of the offer amounts, with interest at each offer's APR, due after `duration`.
The lender, not the borrower, pays the protocol cut of the fee to the protocol fee recipient.
A non-empty callbackData calls a whitelisted callback contract; for an EOA signer it reverts.
formats.shown: Borrow against NFT: the collateral NFT, the lender(s), the gross amount(s), APR, the maximum lender fee, duration, principal receiver, expiry, callback data and borrower.

findings.title: emitLoan shows the gross 'Amount' and does not say the lender fee is taken from it.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan.sol _processOffersFromExecutionData: `fee = offer.fee.mulDivUp(amount, offer.principalAmount); ... safeTransferFrom(lender, _principalReceiver, amount - fee);`. Descriptor shows 'Amount' and 'Lender fee (max)' as separate fields. Case 0: screen 'Amount 1 WETH', signer received 0.977556109725685785 WETH. Case 11: screen '10000 USDC', signer received 9919.137466 USDC.
findings.fix: Rename 'Amount' to 'Loan amount (fee deducted)' and 'Lender fee (max)' to 'Fee deducted from amount (max)'. Add interpolatedIntent "Borrow {amount} against {tokenId}".

findings.title: emitLoan shows lenders, amounts, APRs and fees as separate lists the signer cannot pair per offer.
findings.evidence: Descriptor fields `offerExecution.[].offer.lender`, `offerExecution.[].amount`, `offerExecution.[].offer.aprBps`, `offerExecution.[].offer.fee` are four independent array fields; the contract builds one tranche per offer (`tranche[i] = Tranche(loanId, totalAmount, amount, lender, 0, block.timestamp, offer.aprBps)`).
findings.fix: Group the per-offer fields under one field group on `offerExecution.[]` so each offer renders lender, amount, APR and fee together, and add a multi-offer test case.

findings.title: emitLoan shows callback data as raw bytes, which only a whitelisted callback contract can use.
findings.evidence: CallbackHandler.handleAfterPrincipalTransferCallback: `if (!_isWhitelistedCallbackContract[_callbackAddress] || ...) revert`; descriptor field 'Callback data' format raw.
findings.fix: Hide 'Callback data' or label it 'Callback data (contracts only)'.

cases.notes: WETH in 0.9776 shown as 'Amount 1 WETH' plus a separate max fee; NFT out shown as Collateral.
USDC in 9919.137466 shown as 10000 USDC plus a separate 80.86 USDC max fee; the reader guessed the fee may be deducted.

formats.key: repayLoan(((uint256 loanId, bytes callbackData, bool shouldDelegate) data, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) loan, bytes borrowerSignature) _repaymentData)
effects: For each tranche, the borrower pays principal + carried accruedInterest + new interest (minus the protocol cut) to the tranche lender.
The borrower pays the protocol cut of the interest to the protocol fee recipient.
The collateral NFT moves from the loan contract back to the borrower.
If shouldDelegate is true, the loan contract registers a delegate.xyz delegation of the NFT to the borrower.
A non-empty callbackData runs a whitelisted callback after the NFT transfer; for an EOA signer it reverts.
formats.shown: Repay loan: the loan ID, the collateral NFT, the loan principal, the borrower, the lender(s), the delegate flag and the callback data.

findings.title: repayLoan shows only the principal; it hides the tranche APR and the carried interest the borrower also pays.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._processRepayments: `repayment = tranche.principalAmount + tranche.accruedInterest + newInterest - thisProtocolFee; asset.safeTransferFrom(loan.borrower, tranche.lender, repayment);` and `safeTransferFrom(loan.borrower, _protocolFee.recipient, totalProtocolFee)`. Descriptor hides `tranche.[].aprBps`, `tranche.[].accruedInterest` and `tranche.[].startTime`. Case 1: screen 'Loan principal 3 WETH', signer paid 3.000985753424657535 WETH. Case 12: screen '10000 USDC', signer paid 10016.788877 USDC.
findings.fix: Make `tranche.[].aprBps` visible as 'Tranche APR' (unit, %, 2 decimals) and `tranche.[].accruedInterest` as 'Carried interest' (tokenAmount), and relabel 'Loan principal' to 'Principal (interest added at repayment)'.

findings.title: repayLoan total depends on block time, so no field can show the exact amount paid.

cases.notes: NFT in is implied by intent and Collateral; WETH out 3.000986 shown only as 3 WETH principal.
NFT in implied; USDC out 10016.79 shown only as 10000 USDC principal.

formats.key: refinanceFull((uint256 renegotiationId, uint256 loanId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256[] trancheIndex, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration) _renegotiationOffer, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) _loan, bytes _renegotiationOfferSignature)
effects: Lender-initiated: the new lender pays every other current lender their principal plus accrued interest (minus the protocol cut).
Lender-initiated: the new lender pays all protocol fees (the cut of the renegotiation fee and of accrued interest) to the protocol fee recipient.
Lender-initiated: if the new principal is larger, the new lender sends the difference to the borrower.
Lender-initiated: the new lender gets one tranche with the new principal, APR and duration, carrying the accrued interest it paid.
Borrower-initiated: the new lender funds up to principal minus fee; the borrower pays any shortfall of old debt and protocol fees, and receives the remainder.
The old loan is deleted and replaced by a new loan ID with the new terms.
formats.shown: Refinance loan: loan ID, new lender, new principal, new APR, new duration, lender fee, offer expiry, tranche index, collateral, current principal, borrower and current lenders.

findings.title: refinanceFull never says the signer pays current lenders principal plus interest and pays protocol fees.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._processOldTranche: `oldLenderDebt = _tranche.principalAmount + accruedInterest - thisProtocolFee; ... asset.safeTransferFrom(_lender, _tranche.lender, oldLenderDebt);` and _processOldTranchesFull: `_handleProtocolFeeForFee(_loan.principalAddress, _renegotiationOffer.lender, lenderFee, _protocolFee.recipient)`. Descriptor: intent 'Refinance loan', field 'New principal'; tranche APR, startTime, accruedInterest and `_loan.protocolFee` are visible: never. Case 2: signer sent 20.292289 WETH to the current lender and 0.011063 WETH to 0x4169…5562; screen shows only 'New principal 20 WETH'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Refinance loan: pay current lenders'. Make `_loan.tranche.[].aprBps`, `_loan.tranche.[].accruedInterest` and `_loan.protocolFee` visible, and relabel 'New principal' to 'Principal you fund (plus accrued interest)'. Add interpolatedIntent "Pay off {_loan.tranche.[].lender} and lend {principalAmount}".

findings.title: refinanceFull shows 'Tranche index' as raw integers that have no meaning to a signer.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan.refinanceFull: `if (_renegotiationOffer.trancheIndex.length != _loan.tranche.length) revert`; descriptor field 'Tranche index' format raw.
findings.fix: Hide `trancheIndex.[]` in refinanceFull, where it must cover every tranche.

cases.notes: Signer paid 20.3034 WETH (principal, accrued interest, protocol fee); the screen shows only a 20 WETH new principal and no outflow.

formats.key: refinancePartial((uint256 renegotiationId, uint256 loanId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256[] trancheIndex, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration) _renegotiationOffer, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) _loan)
effects: The signer must be the new lender, set by the offer.
For each selected tranche held by another lender, the signer pays that lender principal plus accrued interest minus the protocol cut.
The signer pays the protocol cut of the accrued interest of all selected tranches to the protocol fee recipient.
The signer takes over the selected tranches at the new APR, carrying their accrued interest; the loan gets a new ID.
formats.shown: Refinance loan tranches: loan ID, new lender, new principal, new APR, offer expiry, tranche indexes, collateral, loan principal, borrower and current lenders.

findings.title: refinancePartial does not show the signer's payment to current lenders and the protocol fee.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan.refinancePartial calls `_processOldTranche(_renegotiationOffer.lender, ..., type(uint256).max)`, which runs `asset.safeTransferFrom(_lender, _tranche.lender, oldLenderDebt)`, then `_handleProtocolFeeForFee(_loan.principalAddress, _renegotiationOffer.lender, totalProtocolFee, _protocolFee.recipient)`. `_loan.protocolFee` and tranche APR/accruedInterest are visible: never. Case 3: signer paid 0.00000064794520548 WETH to 0x4169…5562; nothing on screen states it.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Buy loan tranches from current lenders'. Show `_loan.tranche.[].aprBps`, `_loan.tranche.[].accruedInterest` and `_loan.protocolFee`, and relabel 'New principal' to 'Principal you pay (plus accrued interest)'.

findings.title: refinancePartial 'Loan principal' and 'Current lender' list every tranche, not the selected ones.
findings.evidence: Descriptor shows `_loan.principalAmount` and `_loan.tranche.[].lender` for all tranches, while the code only processes `_loan.tranche[_renegotiationOffer.trancheIndex[i]]`; 'Tranche index' is raw.
findings.fix: Label the tranche lender field 'Lenders (all tranches)', and add a test with a multi-tranche loan.

cases.notes: Signer was already the lender, so only the protocol fee left; the screen does not mention it.

formats.key: addNewTranche((uint256 renegotiationId, uint256 loanId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256[] trancheIndex, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration) _renegotiationOffer, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) _loan, bytes _renegotiationOfferSignature)
effects: The signer must be the borrower.
The new lender sends principalAmount minus fee of the principal token to the borrower.
The borrower's debt grows by principalAmount in a new junior tranche at the new APR; the loan end date does not change.

The loan gets a new loan ID.

findings.title: addNewTranche 'New principal' does not say the borrower receives it minus the fee and owes it.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan.addNewTranche: `safeTransferFrom(_renegotiationOffer.lender, _loan.borrower, _renegotiationOffer.principalAmount - _renegotiationOffer.fee)` and _addNewTranche: `_loan.principalAmount += _renegotiationOffer.principalAmount`. Descriptor labels 'New principal' next to 'Loan principal 29 WETH'. Case 4: signer received 7 WETH; reader unsure whether 7 WETH arrives or the total becomes 36 WETH.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Borrow more against loan' and relabel 'New principal' to 'Extra amount borrowed (fee deducted)'. Add interpolatedIntent "Borrow {principalAmount} more from {lender}".

cases.notes: 7 WETH in is shown as 'New principal 7 WETH' with fee 0; the reader was unsure it arrives in the wallet.

findings.format: refinanceFull((uint256 renegotiationId, uint256 loanId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256[] trancheIndex, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration) _renegotiationOffer, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) _loan, bytes _renegotiationOfferSignature)
findings.title: refinanceFull never says the signer pays current lenders principal plus interest and pays protocol fees.
findings.reason: When the lender calls refinanceFull, the signer pays the old lender principal plus accrued interest minus the fee, and pays the protocol fee too. That came to 20.303 WETH in case 2. The screen only shows 20 WETH principal, and the calldata that sets the interest and fee is hidden. So more leaves the wallet than any shown value, and none of the not-critical cases covers this.
findings.quote: MultiSourceLoan._processOldTranche: `oldLenderDebt = _tranche.principalAmount + accruedInterest - thisProtocolFee; ... asset.safeTransferFrom(_lender, _tranche.lender, oldLenderDebt);` and _processOldTranchesFull: `_handleProtocolFeeForFee(_loan.principalAddress, _renegotiationOffer.lender, lenderFee, _protocolFee.recipient);`. Descriptor refinanceFull: `_loan.tranche.[].accruedInterest` / `aprBps` / `startTime` / `_loan.protocolFee` all `visible: never`. Case 2 screen: 'New principal 20 WETH', 'Loan principal 20 WETH'; mined: signer sends 20.292289 WETH to 0x9dac…3986 and 0.011063 WETH to 0x4169…5562.

findings.format: refinancePartial((uint256 renegotiationId, uint256 loanId, address lender, uint256 fee, uint256[] trancheIndex, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 aprBps, uint256 expirationTime, uint256 duration) _renegotiationOffer, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee) _loan)
findings.title: refinancePartial does not show the signer's payment to current lenders and the protocol fee.
findings.reason: The signer of refinancePartial is always the new lender. They pay the protocol fee on accrued interest out of their own wallet. They also pay the old lenders principal plus interest. The screen states none of this: the fee fraction and the tranche interest inputs are hidden calldata. Case 3 shows a real WETH transfer from the signer that nothing on screen states.
findings.quote: MultiSourceLoan.refinancePartial: `if (msg.sender != _renegotiationOffer.lender) revert InvalidCallerError();` then `_processOldTranche(_renegotiationOffer.lender, ..., type(uint256).max)` (sends principal + accruedInterest - fee to `_tranche.lender` when it differs from the signer) and `_handleProtocolFeeForFee(_loan.principalAddress, _renegotiationOffer.lender, totalProtocolFee, _protocolFee.recipient);`. Descriptor: `_loan.protocolFee`, `_loan.tranche.[].accruedInterest`, `aprBps` set to `visible: never`. Case 3 mined: signer sends 0.00000064794520548 WETH to 0x4169…5562; screen shows only 'New principal 0.03 WETH'.

findings.title: refinancePartial does not show the signer's payment to current lenders and the protocol fee.
findings.reason: Case 3 pays the undisclosed protocol fee, although it makes no current-lender payment because the signer already owns that tranche. This qualification does not refute the hidden asset outflow: the screen omits both the fee and its calldata rate.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0xf41b389e0c1950dc0b16c9498eae77131cc08a56/src/src/lib/loans/MultiSourceLoan.sol, _processOldTranche: `if (_lender != _tranche.lender) { asset.safeTransferFrom(_lender, _tranche.lender, oldLenderDebt); }`; refinancePartial: `_handleProtocolFeeForFee(_loan.principalAddress, _renegotiationOffer.lender, totalProtocolFee, _protocolFee.recipient);`. cases/3.json, refinancePartial mined effect: `"symbol": "WETH", "decimals": 18, "amount": "647945205480"`, `"to": "0x4169447a424ec645f8a24dccfd8328f714dd5562", "signer": "out"`; screen: `"intent": "Refinance loan tranches"`, `"label": "New principal", "value": "0.03 WETH"`. descriptor.json, refinancePartial: `"path": "_loan.protocolFee", "label": "Protocol fee", "visible": "never"`.
